rule: Read every experiment whose next_reading has passed before starting new work, then record the verdict here and in BTC500_GROWTH.md. Do not open a new experiment while `open` equals `max_open`: close, merge or read one first. Preflight reports due readings in preflight.json.

experiments.what: Publish the live T-500 buy date on /halving-dates plus a 30-day-reminder .ics calendar feed.
experiments.hypothesis: An exact, calendar-ready buy date is the answer people search for around the window; owning it earns the click.
experiments.success: Any non-brand click, or a new referring domain, before the buy window opens.
experiments.inconclusive: Impressions stay under 20 for the 28-day window.
experiments.verdict: Closed 2026-10-27 by the third failing review. /halving-dates is 'Crawled - currently not indexed' (last crawl 2026-10-22) and has 0 impressions in 28 days, so the calendar feed cannot be tested at all: the success condition needs a served page. Read as a distribution failure, not a feature failure. Replace with sitemap-contraction.

experiments.what: Publish the drawdown record behind the 500-day rule at /bitcoin-500-day-cycle#risk-heading (median -11.7%, worst -84%, 85 days to the low).
experiments.hypothesis: The one number nobody else publishes (-84% inside a rule people call safe) is the quotable asset that earns links.
experiments.success: A new referring domain, a mention in a newsletter or data roundup, or a non-brand click on #risk-heading.
experiments.inconclusive: Zero referring domains and under 20 impressions on the section.
experiments.verdict: Merged into distribution-test on 2026-10-25. Its success condition (a referring domain or non-brand click) cannot resolve without distribution, and the site has issued no posts and has no referring domains. The drawdown numbers are now the payload of the owner asks.

experiments.what: Publish the entry-timing test at /bitcoin-500-day-cycle#timing-heading: every completed window re-run with the entry moved +/-120 days at a fixed T+500 exit.
experiments.hypothesis: Publishing what a wrong entry date costs answers the real question behind 'when should I buy' better than a chart of the rule itself.
experiments.success: Any non-brand click or new referring domain by 2026-11-20.
experiments.verdict: Merged into distribution-test on 2026-10-25 for the same reason as drawdown-study: it measures the effect of a page that is not indexed and has never been linked. Its table is the payload of the community ask.

experiments.what: One X post from @btc500halving carrying the drawdown number, one community comment carrying the entry-timing table (both pointing at /bitcoin-500-day-cycle), and 3 send-ready pitches in scripts/autonomous/outreach/.
experiments.hypothesis: The first external mention is what turns 6/25 indexed into a crawled site. One real referral is evidence the page is worth linking; zero referrals after a finished post means the channel or the audience is wrong.
experiments.success: At least 1 GA4 referral session from any channel we asked (x.com, twitter.com, reddit.com, bitcointalk.org, bitcoinmagazine.com, bitcoin-only.com), or 1 new indexed URL, by 2026-11-08.
experiments.inconclusive: scripts/autonomous/outreach/STATUS.md shows no ask with a send date by 2026-11-04. Then the test measured the owner's availability, not the channel, and is void — close it and issue the next ask on the one channel the ledger proves is usable.
progress: 2026-10-28: written down as unmeasurable, not just unsent — STATUS.md records handed-over dates and `sent: no` for all three asks (2026-10-27). Referrals 7d: github.com 7, every asked channel 0. Success widened to any asked channel so the reading is not tied to X, which produced 0 sends in 3 days.

experiments.what: Rewrote the title, meta description and first sentence of /bitcoin-500-day-cycle so they lead with the live T-500 date ('November 28, 2026: 500 Days Before the Next Bitcoin Halving') instead of 'Bitcoin 500-Day Cycle | BTC500', and published /data/500-day-cycles.json plus a citation block on the same page.
experiments.hypothesis: The two exact-intent queries already put the site at 9.07 and 11.0 with 0 clicks out of 20 impressions, and the old title answered neither query. A snippet that states the answer should earn the click once the URL is served, and the citation surface gives a writer something to quote instead of paraphrase.
experiments.success: The pillar is indexed on 2026-11-19, or a click lands on any of the 3 cluster queries ('when is / what is 500 days before the next bitcoin halving', 'bitcoin 500 day cycle') in the 28 days after the change.
experiments.inconclusive: Pillar still 'Crawled - currently not indexed' on 2026-11-19 — then the snippet was never served and the test measured indexation, not the snippet; close it as unreadable rather than extending it.

experiments.what: Merge or 301 the five URLs last crawled 2026-08-09 → 2026-08-22 (/articles, /articles/bitcoin-volatility, /articles/bitcoin-infrastructure-exploits, /articles/ondo-finance-tokenization, /liquidation) into at most two pages, and drop them from sitemap.xml.
experiments.hypothesis: A four-month-old domain with 0 referring domains has a crawl budget set by authority, not by URL count. 25 URLs, 13 declined and 6 never fetched, means Google spends its visits re-declining the same inventory. Removing dead weight should let the remaining 20 URLs be crawled and indexed at a higher rate, and the indexed count is the only signal that can move first.
experiments.success: Indexed rises from the 2026-10-28 base of 5 of 22 to 8 or more of 22 by 2026-11-10, or any of the three redirected slugs' target (/articles) is crawled after 2026-10-28 and indexed.
experiments.inconclusive: Indexed stays at 5 or fewer with the sitemap at 22 by 2026-11-10 — then crawl budget was not the limit and only external links can move it; stop all in-repo indexation work permanently and spend every cycle on distribution only.
progress: 2026-10-28: shipped. 301 -> /articles for /articles/bitcoin-volatility, /articles/bitcoin-infrastructure-exploits and /articles/ondo-finance-tokenization (routes, metadata, components and sitemap rows deleted). /articles and /liquidation kept, per the mandate. Sitemap 25 -> 22.
